description: This file defines the ReadableShippingSummaryPopulator class, which converts a ShippingSummary object into a ReadableShippingSummary object, populating display-related fields for order shipping summaries.

classes.name: ReadableShippingSummaryPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for converting ShippingSummary objects into ReadableShippingSummary representations for web presentation.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a ReadableShippingSummary object with data from a ShippingSummary source, using store and language context.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ReadableShippingSummary as the target object for population.

methods.name: getPricingService
methods.description: Returns the PricingService used for formatting amounts.

methods.name: setPricingService
methods.description: Injects the PricingService dependency into the populator.
